title: Mandatory limited-fund classes
summary: A limited-fund class addresses a situation where separate claims could exhaust a genuinely insufficient fund and impair other claimants’ recovery. Mandatory treatment requires strong justification because class members lack the ordinary damages-class opt-out choice.
notes: A desire for a global settlement is not enough. Differences in injury timing and insurance rights can create representation conflicts even where the aggregate fund appears substantial.

sections.Meaning: A limited-fund class addresses a situation where separate claims could exhaust a genuinely insufficient fund and impair other claimants’ recovery. Mandatory treatment requires strong justification because class members lack the ordinary damages-class opt-out choice.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify and substantiate the fund’s limit, compare it with the competing claims, and examine inclusion and equitable treatment of the affected claimants. Ortiz rejects relying solely on the parties’ negotiated contribution as proof of a limited fund.
